title: Bound Windows Cloudflared logfile release before fresh-origin evidence

phases.objective: Prevent Windows service reconciliation from racing cloudflared logfile-handle release after SCM reports the service stopped.

e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The reconciler obtains exclusive write ownership of the Staging cloudflared logfile within a bounded window, truncates only after ownership is obtained, and then starts the namespaced Staging service for fresh remote-origin evidence.
steps: Stop the namespaced Mad4B-Staging-Cloudflared Windows service.
Attempt exclusive logfile ownership with FileShare.None.
Retry bounded sharing violations for up to 15 seconds instead of failing on the first WriteAllText race.
Truncate the logfile only after exclusive ownership is obtained.
Fail closed if the logfile remains locked beyond the bounded window.
assertions: No generic Cloudflared service is stopped, killed, or reconfigured.
The logfile reset uses exclusive write ownership and a bounded retry.
Persistent lock contention still fails closed with a diagnostic message.
No Production deployment, database mutation, provider mutation, DNS mutation, ruleset mutation, or secret disclosure is authorized.
